Last Updated 11th February, 2020
[Dated 1st April, 1958]
Published in the Assam Gazette, Extraordinary, dated 28th March, 1958.
[Received the assent of the Governor on the 26th March, 1958]
An Act further to amend the Court-Fees Act, 1870 (Act 7 of 1870) in its application to Assam.
Preamble. - Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Court-Fees Act, 1870 (Act 7 of 1870) hereinafter called the
Principal Act, in its application to Assam, in the manner hereinafter appearing:
It is hereby enacted in the Ninth Year of the Republic of India as follows:-
Page 1/19
 
The Assam Court-Fees (Amendment) Act, 1958

1.
Short title, extent and commencement.
(1)
This Act may be called the Assam Court-Fees (Amendment) Act, 1958.
(2)
It extends to the whole of the State of Assam.
(3)
It shall come into force with effect from the 1st April, 1958.

3.
Amendment of Schedule I, Article 6.
- In the third column in Article 6 of Schedule I or the words "eight annas" opposite Clause (a) in the second column, the
words "fifty naye paise" shall be substituted.

4.

- For the table of rates of ad valorem fees leviable on the institution of suits, at the end of Schedule 1 to the principal Act,
